args.text: Hi Ruth, Gideon Sato asked me to email the Hartford incident timeline (first report, kiosk 1 back, both lanes back) to Odile Brandt at Carrowmere Cloud so she can match it to their gateway logs. Because she is outside pemberline.com, I need your approval before anything is sent or drafted. Can you reply here to approve or decline? Note the address Gideon gave (odile.brandt@carrowmere.example) differs from the directory entry (odilebrandt@carrowmere.example); please confirm which is right.

Gideon, I haven't sent the email to Odile yet. She's at Carrowmere Cloud, outside pemberline.com, and our rules require Ruth Calloway's approval before any mail goes to an outside address, even as a draft. I've asked Ruth in a DM to approve or decline.

Two things to confirm when you hear back:
- **Address:** you gave odile.brandt@carrowmere.example, but the directory lists odilebrandt@carrowmere.example. I asked Ruth to confirm which one is correct, and I'll use whichever she confirms.
- **Timeline:** I found the Hartford thread in #inc-vtg-hartford. The key points are: kiosks went offline and both lanes showed a white screen (Aug 3, around 10:42), kiosk 1 came back (around 11:03), and both lanes were working again at 11:07. I'll send the full timeline once Ruth approves.
